Sidebar logo '[data-testid=sharago-logo]' renders 'Sharago' (S + gold 'ago'). /garage doc.title='Sharago — Twój wirtualny garaż', footer '2026 Sharago. Submitting at Free cap → [rental-limit-modal] visible with [rental-limit-close]='Anuluj' + [rental-limit-upgrade]='Przejdź na Premium', backend returned 402. /marketplace/<rental_id> renders [listing-rental-block] with prices/availability/pickup/requirements AND [listing-rental-disclaimer] with text 'Sharago jest platformą ogłoszeniową...'. /marketplace/mine renders [my-listings-filter] with 3 buttons [my-listings-filter-{all,classic,rental}] — selecting 'Wynajem' filters to only the Audi A4 rental.

minor.issue: Blog item author still says 'Zespół VEHIQ' / 'noreply@vehiq.pl' in the existing seeded blog post. Per spec the email sender intentionally stays vehiq.pl (Brevo not yet verified for sharago.pl), but the author label 'Zespół VEHIQ' is content-level and could be updated to 'Zespół Sharago' via /api/admin/blog if desired (not a code bug — DB content).

ui_bugs.issue: Spec said the badge should read 'Prywatny' for owner_type='private'. Actual UI renders 'Osoba prywatna' instead. Cosmetic / wording deviation only. [listing-business-badge] is correctly omitted for private listings.

Intermittent: visiting /blog and /blog/<slug> sometimes shows document.title='Sharago — Twój wirtualny garaż' (the static index.html title) instead of the spec'd 'Blog Sharago — porady, historie i nowości' / '{title} — Blog Sharago'. Same root cause as iter10's canonical override bug — react-helmet-async appends/replaces head tags but the static <title> from /app/frontend/index.html persists when Helmet hasn't yet mounted (and our test run hit Cloudflare 429s on those navigations which may have aborted Helmet hydration). Recommend: remove the static <title>/<link rel=canonical> from index.html or set a default Helmet wrapper in App.js.

issues: The top-level 'Cena (PLN)' input is HTML5 `required` even when type='rental' / category=rental_car (where CreateListing.js overrides payload.price = rental.price_per_day on submit). User MUST also fill the top Cena field even though it's auto-overridden — confusing UX. Consider hiding the top-level Cena field (or removing `required`) when category∈{rental_car, rental_garage}.

action_items: (LOW) Optionally update Polish badge text 'Osoba prywatna' → 'Prywatny' to match spec wording in ListingDetail.js for the owner_type='private' badge.

(MEDIUM) Hide or remove `required` from the top-level 'Cena (PLN)' input on CreateListing.js when category∈{rental_car, rental_garage} — the rental-price-day already drives payload.price, so the legacy Cena field forces an extra dummy entry.

(MEDIUM) Carry-over from iter10: remove static <title> + <link rel=canonical> from /app/frontend/index.html (or wrap App.js in a default Helmet) so per-route Helmet titles like 'Blog Sharago — ...' actually override. Currently intermittent.
(LOW) Update the blog post 'Zespół VEHIQ' author label → 'Zespół Sharago' via admin API for full content-level rebrand consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace.py — RentalDetails Pydantic model + RENTAL_CATEGORIES whitelist + 402 detail.code='rental_limit_free' is well-structured. ALL_CATEGORIES = RENTAL_CATEGORIES is a forward-looking alias — fine.

marketplace.py line 219 `is_rental = payload.category in RENTAL_CATEGORIES` — correct. Limit-check correctly excludes business plans, owner_type=business, and counts only category∈{rental_car,rental_garage} with status=active. Good.
marketplace.py — category=rental shorthand correctly maps to $in: [rental_car, rental_garage]; multi-cat comma-split also supported.

CreateListing.js — listing-price input remains `required` even for rentals; payload.price is overridden to rental.price_per_day on submit but HTML5 validation forces the user to enter a dummy value. UX gap noted in design_issues.
Sharago logo SVG (Logo.js) — 'S' + 'ago' gold split renders correctly and has data-testid='sharago-logo'. Good.
storageMigration.js — runs on boot, copies vehiq_* → sharago_* before render. Verified: post-login localStorage contains only sharago_token / sharago_session / sharago_lang.
Listing detail rental block ([listing-rental-block]) correctly conditional on category∈{rental_car,rental_garage}. Disclaimer mentions Sharago verbatim. Good.
MyListings filter [my-listings-filter-{all,classic,rental}] — clean 3-button tab, fires client-side category filter. Good.

rca of the issue: Rebrand/rental implementation is solid. The only functional gap is the legacy top-level 'Cena (PLN)' field being `required` on /marketplace/new for type='rental' — the user has to enter a redundant value because payload.price is overridden server-side to rental.price_per_day. Recommend conditional `required={form.category !== 'rental_car' && form.category !== 'rental_garage'}` in CreateListing.js or hide the field entirely for rentals.
